extracted.name: How to Cook Rice
extracted.description: Learn how to cook rice on the stove! This easy method yields soft, fluffy white rice every time.
instruction_lines: Combine the rinsed rice, water, and olive oil in a pot and bring to a boil. Cover, reduce the heat, and simmer for 15 minutes, or until the liquid is absorbed.
Remove from the heat and let it sit, covered, for 10 more minutes. Fluff with a fork.
